name: skill-router
description: Route requests to disabled Codex skills with fast and DCI-style corpus routing, and manage installed skills based on usage.

interface.shortDescription: Route and manage stale Codex skills
interface.longDescription: Skill Router routes long-tail requests to disabled Codex skills using fast lexical routing plus DCI-style direct corpus search, audits installed skills, suggests unused or stale entries, and safely disables selected skills by renaming SKILL.md files so they can be restored later.
defaultPrompt: Route this request to a disabled skill
